name: Compromise amendment
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 6a. Reaffirms the EU’s commitment to promoting and protecting women’s health, dignity and access to high-quality healthcare and support services across the EU; recalls that the organisation and delivery of health services and medical care, including policies relating to reproductive health, remain primarily the competence of the Member States, in accordance with the principle of subsidiarity enshrined in the Treaties, and must respect national legal frameworks; considers, therefore, that EU budgetary instruments should focus on supporting preventive, maternal and women’s healthcare, and research on and the reduction of health inequalities; underlines, in this context, that the implementation of EU funding should duly respect Member States’ competences and the funding should not be used to directly finance procedures in areas where Member States retain primary responsibility; stresses the importance of maintaining a respectful and evidence-based dialogue that safeguards women’s rights and well-being while preserving European unity on sensitive ethical matters;
